_law: SOURCE OF TRUTH. Every scene reads a character from this file by key and never re-types its look. Changing a character here changes it everywhere; changing it anywhere else is a redesign and fails the build. Each entry carries the ten fields the channel character template requires.

boy.name: The Boy
boy.appearance: Twelve or so. Slight, a head shorter than any adult. Stands with his weight back, as if about to step away from whatever he is looking at.
boy.face: Large dark eyes set wide, a small nose, a thin mouth. Heavy dark brows that do most of the work when he is frightened.
boy.hair: Messy black, tufts breaking the silhouette in every direction. Never tidy, in any scene.
boy.clothing: Dark navy-black zip hoodie over a grey tee, dark jeans, white trainers. No accessories - nothing to catch the eye but the face.

proportions.note: head is about one quarter of total height

boy.personality: Watches before he moves. Does what frightens him anyway, a second later than he should.

voice.note: low for his age, flat, running slightly out of breath

father.name: Father
father.role: Parent - dead by the time the story starts
father.appearance: Mid forties, tall and narrow, shoulders rounded. Always standing a little too still.
father.face: Long, tired, deep lines. Heavy brows above wide eyes that do not blink enough.
father.hair: Short black, receding at the temples. A thick black moustache.
father.clothing: Pale blue work shirt with the sleeves rolled, dark brown trousers, brown shoes. Dried blood across the chest and one sleeve.
father.personality: Was the one who checked the locks. Still is.

voice.note: quiet, slow, gentle - the calm is the wrong part

mother.name: Mother
mother.role: Parent - dead by the time the story starts
mother.appearance: Early forties, small, upright. Hands held in front of her.
mother.face: Round, pale, dark eyes. Brows permanently raised slightly inward.
mother.hair: Shoulder-length black, parted in the middle, tucked behind one ear.
mother.clothing: Deep maroon button dress with a belt, dark flat shoes. Blood spotted across the bodice.
mother.personality: Asks a question she already knows the answer to.

voice.note: warm, a little high, breaks at the end of a sentence

entity.name: The Creature
entity.appearance: Over two and a half metres. Completely hairless. Smooth pale grey skin stretched over a ribcage you can count. Arms far too long, hanging past the knees, ending in thin fingers. Never stands straight - always slouched forward, head low.
entity.face: A swollen smooth cranium narrowing to a small jaw. NO EYES AT ALL. No nose. No mouth. There is nothing on it to read, and that is the design.
entity.personality: Does not hurry. Is always already closer than it was.

voice.note: no speech - breath, joints, and the sound of weight on a floor

entity._law: ONE-CREATURE LAW: only wet, burnt, blood and tilt may differ between shots.

girl.name: The Girl
girl.appearance: Eleven or twelve. Small, straight-backed, chin slightly up.
girl.face: Wide dark eyes, round cheeks, a small mouth held closed.
girl.hair: Dark brown, long and loose past the shoulders, slightly waved.
girl.clothing: Dark red dress with a pale collar and a belt, dark buckled shoes.
girl.personality: Says the thing nobody else will say.

voice.note: clear, high, steadier than it should be

oldman.name: The Old Man
oldman.appearance: Very tall and very thin, stooped. Carries a lantern that is the only warm light in any frame he is in.
oldman.face: Hollow cheeks, deep sockets, a long nose.
oldman.hair: White, thin, swept back. A full white beard.
oldman.clothing: Long brown coat to the shins, a dark red scarf, heavy boots.
oldman.personality: Answers the question after the one you asked.

voice.note: dry, slow, a rasp at the end of each line

villain.name: The Villain
villain.appearance: Tall, narrow, moves without hurry. A long black coat to the ankles makes one unbroken vertical shape.
villain.face: Sharp, pale, hard angles. Eyebrows that sit high and sloped.
villain.hair: Black, swept straight back from a widow's peak.
villain.clothing: Floor-length black coat over a black shirt, black boots.
villain.personality: Enjoys the part before the thing happens.

ghost.name: The Ghost
ghost.appearance: A young woman, barefoot, not quite touching the ground. Edges cold and faintly lit from inside.
ghost.face: Pale blue, eyes with no dark centre at all.
ghost.hair: Long, pale, drifting as if underwater.
ghost.personality: Repeats herself. Does not know she is doing it.

voice.note: doubled, a half-beat of reverb behind every word

scarecrow.name: The Scarecrow
scarecrow.appearance: Human-sized but wrong in the joints. Straw bursting from every cuff, collar and hem.
scarecrow.face: A sacking head under a wide straw hat. Two burning orange points where the eyes should be, and a stitched line for a mouth.
scarecrow.clothing: Ragged brown coat and trousers, wide straw hat.
scarecrow.personality: Stands in one place for a very long time. Then does not.

voice.note: no voice - straw, wind, and a dry creak

police.name: Police Officer
police.appearance: Broad, square, stands with hands at his belt.
police.face: Heavy jaw, flat expression, thick moustache.
police.hair: Short dark, mostly under the cap.
police.clothing: Dark navy uniform, peaked cap, belt, black boots.
police.personality: Writes it down. Does not believe it.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.appearance: Slight, stooped at the neck from looking down at things.
doctor.clothing: White coat over a blue shirt, dark trousers, dark shoes.
doctor.personality: Explains the thing that does not explain it.

villager.name: Villager
villager.appearance: Older, solid, hands behind his back.
villager.face: Weathered, kind, deep creases. Full white beard.
villager.clothing: Cream kurta, brown waistcoat, loose trousers, sandals.
villager.personality: Knows the story. Has told it before.

child.name: Child
child.appearance: Seven or eight. Small, round, always slightly turned away.
child.clothing: Cream shirt, dark blue trousers, white trainers.
child.personality: Asks the question everybody is avoiding.
